[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] Household scope remains bounded, continuous, strictly increasing and strictly concave utility on nonnegative consumption; continuous nonnegative resources; and general compactly supported iid labor probability laws with positive lower support and essential distinct endpoints for the risky economy. Atoms are permitted; density and finite support are not required. Smoothness concerns positive consumption only. Mean-one labor is retained for equilibrium aggregation. P03 supplies primitive consistency only. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope; H01–H04 retain their accepted BASIC-only canonical constructions.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M09D1/CapitalComparison.lean] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive resources. Economic zero uses zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal, which may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is distinct. H09's real inequality retains its finite-initial-extended-marginal condition. Accepted positivity, envelope, Euler and almost-everywhere placeholder results retain their separate state, branch and finiteness requirements. G06 introduces no marginal substitution, boundary-finiteness assertion or stationary marginal-integrability claim.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M06B/CrossSectionBridge.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M09A2/EquilibriumDefinition.lean] Original-price normalization retains R=1+r and intercept=-r*phi. Net assets are A-phi, distinct from resources and shifted assets. Predetermined saving pairs with fresh labor; relative to resources z_t, the next draw is l_{t+1}. No contemporaneous saving/labor independence, arbitrary correlated-law factorization or continuum law of large numbers is asserted. Lifetime utility retains its absolutely convergent series of expected flows under finite-history product laws for admitted measurable full-history feasible plans. P01 remains budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi.

[dep:G05; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M09C4/CertaintySteadyState.lean] The certainty benchmark uses the same preferences and production economy, deterministic labor one, r=lambda and beta*R=1. Its net capital is K(lambda), shifted saving is K+phi, and its positive constant consumption is globally verified through the accepted supporting-line and present-value argument. Certainty borrowing limits use mean labor, not the risky labor floor. G06 uses this accepted benchmark certificate; it does not reprove G05 or substitute strict-impatience certainty stationarity.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M09A2/EquilibriumDefinition.lean] Resource and net-asset integrability are supplied by the accepted equilibrium witness. They justify interpreting the real net-asset integral as economic capital. G06 performs no ENNReal-to-Real conversion and no limiting operation. Weak convergence alone still does not imply moment convergence; weak drift does not imply finite-time entry. Accepted local-common-support and arbitrary-initial-law moment restrictions remain unchanged.

[dep:F01; dep:G04; dep:G05] Certified predecessor interfaces are used as accepted facts, with relevant packaged helper definitions inspected. Their entire transitive proofs are not independently recertified here. Firm optimization concerns the capital-labor ratio with labor normalized to one, not uniqueness of firm scale. G04 supplies subcriticality universally; no G02/G03 witness restriction or A05 comparison is used.

[source:A94; verify:sources; ledger:G06] Both extraction pages were rendered in memory with Ghostscript and visually inspected without OCR. Extraction pages 1–2 correspond to printed pp. 670–671 and original PDF pp. 13–14. Page 670 supplies decreasing capital demand and normalized factor pricing; page 671 supplies the certainty benchmark, equilibrium clearing and higher risky-economy capital. Notes 24–25 withhold asset-supply monotonicity and uniqueness; notes 26–27 concern separate growth and saving interpretations. The exact universal Lean composition is a project reconstruction. The extracted artifact matched its indexed SHA-256; original-source validation relies on the packaged controller evidence.
